Name: Minakie's Custom Furniture
Author: Minakie
TagLine: Adds some extra furniture to the game that can be obtained through the Furniture Catalogue (sold at the Carpenter's Shop).
Description:
__**_<s>![](https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png) </s>_**__
This mod adds new furniture to the game.
Most of them are static, but the tip jar, piggy bank and all the coffers have an animated version as well.
![](https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/5072/5072-1577907441-828159490.gif)
These items can be obtained through the Furniture Catalogue (sold at the Carpenter's Shop).

![](https://i.postimg.cc/Fzts1wpW/beware.png)

Custom Furniture is currently outdated. You will need to [get the unofficial update here](https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-4.156000/page-19#post-3353793). Also, bear in mind that, even with that version installed, it is a _**known issue** that the Custom Furniture will some times turn into chairs_ when you relaunch the game. For some people, simply going back to the Title screen and back into the game fixes this issue; for others, sadly it does not. I have a few more furniture pieces already made and coded but have been refraining to update the mod because I was still hopeful that one of the many talented people in our modding community could come up with a more permanent fix for this issue.

**_Updated_**: Routine shared an unofficial update [on the SV Discord](https://discordapp.com/channels/137344473976799233/156109690059751424/669009215184044042) that might fix the issue of the chairs. It's still in the testing phase, but you might wanna give it a try.

_****_![](https://i.postimg.cc/d0qJ6Fgb/installation.png) _****
_
- Make sure you have [SMAPI](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400), [PyTK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726), and [Custom Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254) installed as well
- Have [Furniture Anywhere](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2276) and Custom Furniture Anywhere as well if you'd like to be able to place these furnitures outside your house
- Download my latest file and unzip it
- Navigate to your "__Stardew Valley\Mods"__ folder and drop the extracted folder there
- Run the game to generate the config file (just leave it as-is or tweak the options to your liking)
- Have fun :)

![](https://i.postimg.cc/SxLycR1L/credits.png)

- Thank you [Lumisteria](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844) and blueberry for helping me add 3D perspective to the cat scratching poles/trees/litter boxes
- Fishbowl by [HopeWasHere](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1237)

Downloads.Description:
Adds two dog houses, a bone, a coffee machine, a scarecrow, a tip jar, a piggy bank and four coffers to the game (static).
Also adds a tip jar, piggy bank and four coffers (animated).
